Tooling hazard found while re-gating: validate_mapping.py writes 09_validation_report.json RELATIVE TO CWD. Run from the bundle's parent it writes INTO the read-only bundle; run from anywhere else it silently drops a travel report into an unrelated directory, which is what happened here (removed immediately, bundle digest verified unchanged). Make the output path an explicit argument.
